mapper.insert: INSERT INTO amap_grid_config (region, poi_type, recommended_grid_size, safe_count, max_probe_count, current_batch_no, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{region}, #{poiType}, #{recommendedGridSize}, #{safeCount}, #{maxProbeCount}, #{currentBatchNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (region, poi_type) DO UPDATE SET recommended_grid_size = EXCLUDED.recommended_grid_size, safe_count = EXCLUDED.safe_count, max_probe_count = EXCLUDED.max_probe_count, current_batch_no = EXCLUDED.current_batch_no, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
